name: rubber-segment

frames.best_why: Thumb is stretched long across the track mid-drag, showing the rubber behaviour at full reach.

tagline: The selected tab stretches like elastic as it slides between segments.
summary: A segmented control with a bright sliding thumb. Choosing a segment stretches the thumb toward its new home, and you can drag or flick it across the track.
appearance: A dark rounded track split into evenly spaced text segments, with a white rounded thumb behind the active one. A smaller three-item copy sits below; the active label is dark on white while the rest are pale on grey.
behaviour: Clicking a segment stretches the thumb toward the click, then snaps it into place with a small squash. The thumb can also be grabbed and dragged along the track, and a fast flick throws it into the next slot.
demo_content: Two controls: Day/Week/Month/Year with Week selected, and Overview/Analytics/Reports with Overview selected.
search_phrases: pill tab bar with moving thumb
time period toggle day week month
use_when: A short set of mutually exclusive options needs a compact control with a tactile, draggable indicator.
avoid_when: Best with three to five short labels; equal slots squeeze long words and push the track past narrow parents.
customise: Items, value, default value, size, colours, radius, inset, stretch, squash, speed, glide and drag toggle are props; the spring curves live in the file.
weight_why: A handful of buttons and two animated motion values; it idles once the thumb lands.

a11y.note: Roving tabindex with arrow and Home/End keys mirrors a native radio group; the moving thumb is hidden from assistive tech.

polish_why: The elastic stretch and squash feel physical and stay legible; the springs are well tuned.
title: Rubber Segment
